Title:
Verdant Confluence Marbled Sculptural Diptych

Two hand-formed relief panels exploring the meeting of movement, material and architectural form.

Across a warm ivory ground, green veining spreads through the surface like roots, river systems, moss-covered stone or fragments of an ancient map. Sweeping raised forms emerge from each panel and continue towards the central divide, suggesting branches, folded leaves, flowing water or the curves of a vaulted passage.

The narrow space between the panels becomes part of the composition—a line of separation, but also a place where the two forms appear to meet and continue beyond their individual boundaries.

Changing light deepens the shadows within the relief, revealing new contours across the marbled surface. The precise rectangular format contrasts with the spontaneous patterning of the material, bringing together geometry and chance, structure and organic growth.

Handmade by Boldstone. Each marbled surface develops individually, ensuring that no two pieces can ever be exactly alike.

Created for a private residence in Kensington, London, Icarus brings together a large hand-modelled wall relief with nine individually proportioned companion panels.

The surface suggests fragments of wings, maps, architectural traces or half-remembered signs, reflecting the ideas of movement, aspiration and vulnerability associated with the story of Icarus.
